category.name: Waves & Optics
category.description: Wave mechanics, frequency, wavelength, acoustics, light reflection, and refraction.

lessons.name: Wave Equation
lessons.description: Relates wave propagation speed to its frequency and wavelength.

variables.name: Wave Speed
variables.description: Propagation speed of wave disturbance (SI unit: m/s)

variables.name: Frequency
variables.description: Number of oscillations per second (SI unit: Hz = 1/s)

variables.name: Wavelength (λ)
variables.description: Distance between consecutive crests (SI unit: m)

worked_example.problem: A sound wave has a frequency of 440 Hz and wavelength of 0.77 m. Calculate its speed.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Electromagnetic light waves travel at c ≈ 3 × 10⁸ m/s in vacuum, while acoustic sound waves travel at ≈ 343 m/s in dry 20°C air.

lessons.name: Reflection & Refraction
lessons.description: Laws governing light ray reflection at smooth boundaries and bending across transparent media (Snell's Law).

variables.name: Angle of Reflection
variables.description: Angle equal to angle of incidence (θ_r = θ_i)

variables.name: Refractive Index
variables.description: Ratio of light speed in vacuum to speed in medium (n = c / v)

worked_example.problem: Light enters water (n = 1.33) from air (n = 1.0) at an incident angle of 30°. Find angle of refraction.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Light bends toward the normal line when entering a denser medium with higher refractive index n.
